GAB.note: Counts 29 digital governance acts and says the 2024 Constitution mentions AI, but states no rule, authority or enforcement on AI harms.
Names no AI strategy, its adoption, body or funding.
Mentions data protection only as a theme; no law, authority, regulation or application is stated.
Passages state nothing on government IT staff, ANINF operations, in-house builds or an ICT cadre.
Names the author's publisher but states no local institution's digital policy research, publication or policy role in the passages.
